comparison.objective: Select required conveyor parts and assemble the pictured model while rejecting look-alikes.
comparison.physical_skill: Perception-guided interception, temporary parking, sequencing, stacking, and avoiding conveyor jams.
comparison.success_condition: Two cylinders, beam, and cube assembled on marked sites, all distractors carried off downstream, no part held back, and final model stable for one second.
comparison.reason: This tests online selection and assembly from moving parts. It has no coaxial tool use, hammer impact, fracture, retained-component protection, or small-fragment recovery.
